newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps upgrades Stewart Title rating.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps upgrades Stewart Title rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Wednesday it upgraded the claims paying ability of the Stewart Title Group to Single A Plus from Single A.
The rating applies to Stewart Title Guaranty Co and its wholly owned subsidiary Stewart Title Insurance Co. The companies are ultimately owned by Stewart Information Services Corp.

Duff & Phelps said its action is based on its increased comfort in Stewart's loss reserve adequacy following favorable reviews completed during 1996 by independent consulting actuaries. It also recognizes Stewart's continued progress in technology and Duff & Phelps' recognition of Stewart's better-than-average statutory capital strength.
